content:
As macOS 27 Golden Gate official version is expected to launch later this year, Apple continues to advance beta testing and has now released the fifth beta to developers. Here's a preview of what's included.

Apple releases macOS 27 beta 5

Three weeks ago, Apple released macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 4, and followed up with the corresponding public beta a few days later.

Now, the company is rolling out macOS Golden Gate beta 5, continuing to fix bugs and performance issues in preparation for the official release later this year.

macOS 27 Golden Gate introduces a brand-new Siri app, along with a redesigned Siri AI. The system also features a new AI-powered Shortcuts app that accepts natural language commands to create shortcuts, and provides a prompt-based Safari extension builder.

In addition, macOS 27 Golden Gate brings new Golden Gate-style wallpapers and screensavers, while returning window and app corners to a fixed radius. This reverses a change introduced in macOS 26, which adjusted the corner radius based on the content of each window or app's menu bar.

macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 5 carries the build number 26A5406e. We are diving into this new beta and will bring you our findings shortly.

How to install macOS 27 Golden Gate beta

Here's how to install the macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 5:

  • Back up your Mac
  • Open System Settings
  • Go to General → Software Update
  • Click the "i" icon next to "Beta Updates"
  • From the dropdown menu in the upper right, select "macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta"
  • Click "Done"

Have you discovered any new features in this macOS 27 Golden Gate beta? Let us know in the comments.
